basis: 320 authenticated Stage-A MH-CEM B1024 in-solve timers, RTX3080Ti FP32 batch16
quantile_definition: linear interpolation at (n-1)*p, no nearest-rank substitution
overhead_note: Includes runtime preparation/checkpoint loading/fingerprints, orchestration, atomic writes and summary/bootstrap; no separate component timers. Not online end-to-end latency.

interval_source.note: preflight changes max time/traffic/task setup, does not override these intervals. Historical Raw collection records simulation_interval and continuous grid; future closed-loop wall deadline is not set.

wall_time_vs_simulated_time: Different clocks: 0.1s simulated slot is not a frozen wall-clock deadline.
